title: Super Short Swords PVP
description: This is PVP texturepack made mainly for PVP player and players that enjoy super short swords in Minecraft
body: PVP Texture Pack made for players by players. This texture pack updates the swords in Minecraft with a lot shorter look, giving each weapon a unique and visually appealing design. Perfect for PvP players and anyone who wants to enhance their combat experience. Also great for casual playing
